column1: # Sync log colour classes: the one place for the class names (awto-ddc: per-line text colour in the diagnostic console + host decoder).
# Read by scripts/gen_awto_sync.py (console tables), scripts/sync_log.py (ANSI colour on a TTY), tests/test_sync_classes.py.
# class: name used in the optional 5th column of fw/awto/sync.tsv; no column = normal.
# style: console text style (AWTO_T_STYLE_*, fw/osd/console.c) -> palette entry via tAwtoStyle (fw/osd/text_layer.c).
# ansi: SGR foreground code the host decoder prints on a TTY (0 = none).

column4: green on the console (the existing look); host: terminal default, no escape
